name: font-width
description: > [!NOTE] > The font-width property is the modern replacement for "font-stretch", which is a legacy alias. While font-width is the specification's preferred name, font-stretch currently has broader browser support. Check the fallback example and browser compatibility table for details.
syntax: normal | <percentage [0,∞]> | ultra-condensed | extra-condensed | condensed | semi-condensed | semi-expanded | expanded | extra-expanded | ultra-expanded
